limits: No universal guarantee of focus, Space, minimized-window or website compatibility.
URL checks withhold mismatched results but cannot make host capture/input atomic with navigation or prevent unrelated collection inside a racing host call.
Unsupported browser capabilities stop; all connection, authentication and permission errors are not automatically repairable.
The latest live browser trial used an active target after explicitly allowed preparation. Inactive-tab and physical-typing evidence comes from separate earlier trials with identical guard code.
privacy: No user transcript, native page content, user filesystem paths, chat IDs, credentials or raw diagnostic logs are included.
